provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Read all retained index.html, all 501 source-list lines, independent-check.md, budget.json and director-notes.md. No external page reopened, browser run, network, booking or contact. Independently recomputed retained arithmetic and compared bilingual literals locally without build.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original sandbox browser unavailable; some fetches automatically attempted managed-browser rendering. Successful public rendered bodies included ETIAS, Blue Lagoon admission and Visit Iceland; session/profile provenance not reported, so a fully clean research session cannot be certified. Retained disclosure reports no intentional sign-in/import, forms, account use, contact, booking or payment. Some older source-note provider/line-locator claims were superseded by the final sources.md disclosure. These are original-run limitations, not new research activity.
provenance.verificationScope: Retained independent check is mechanical arithmetic/coherence only, not re-opened external-policy or visual certification. Current authoring uses scoped pure comparison and arithmetic checks only.

datePolicy: Source-specific retrieval/attempt date retained as November 7, 2026 in Singapore, not refreshed by authoring. Failed/shell/index-only accesses are qualified in source notes and visible prose; they do not establish successful current primary verification. Publication dates otherwise unknown. FX table November 2; USD fixing November 6; Polish ETIAS notice September 30; secondary map explanation September 10; rental terms March 25, 2024; MFA update November 6, 2026. Seasonal validity never substitutes for exact February 2027 inventory.
uncertainties: No February 2027 rooms, tour seats/departures, assigned package hotel or lagoon slots confirmed. Seven published hotel offers: only Saga, Frost & Fire and Ranga cover the season; four expire in 2026. No Vik/Skaftafell February quote.

Sky Saman/Ser indexed prices conflict: ISK 14,990/17,990 versus 16,990/19,990. Higher Saman base provisionally used; direct page shell, no confirmed base or slot fare. Lagoon transport and cancellation/current volcanic closure terms incomplete.

ETIAS February 2027 applicability unresolved; no exact start date or fee verified. Retain Singapore-passport short non-working visit assumptions; Chinese language or Singapore residence does not confer eligibility.

ISK 35,000 room/night and ISK 180,000 pair package are allowances, not quotes. SGD 1 = ISK 95 is an indicative rounded planning assumption, not executable FX or forecast. Higher hotel and weaker FX can exhaust the ceiling.

Troll dollar currency unresolved and not converted; direct three-day price differs from cross-sell. Gray Line/RE brand independence not assumed. Advertised starts/sales and pickup fees are not confirmed dated fares.
Cave seasons are product-specific, not fixed guaranteed opening dates; Katla differs from Vatnajokull. Aurora sightings, retries, available rebooking seats and cash refunds are not guaranteed.

Selected fare-class, operator-cancelled multiday cash refunds, partial itinerary changes and consequential accommodation/flight liabilities remain to confirm. Generic voluntary cancellation and aurora rules do not override actual multiday fare terms.

Primary Met Office aurora page timed out; map conventions secondary-supported, check current legend. Nine daylight hours is coarse monthly guidance, not exact-date timetable; no defensible sighting probability.

Rental stock, fit, shop hours/address, delivery cost and exact five-day cancellation boundary unresolved. Incremental daily prices must be summed; every calendar day/part counts. City traction is not glacier equipment.
Flybus selected stops/flight timetable, tour luggage/storage, detailed bus-cap/reset/group payment rules and city hotel breakfast inclusions unresolved. Budget uses singles and breakfast cushion.

Reserve and insurance allowance are not guaranteed disruption coverage. Flights, seventh night, shopping, major equipment, extra tours and extended storm stays not fully covered. Local source list remains a draft-package attachment, not promised public hosting.
editingContract: Only assigned NEW en/slug.md, zh/slug.md, data/slug.json and checks/batch25-slug-notes.md authored. Existing files and source runs immutable; no shared code/inventory/README/manifest edits, builds, network, publication, contact, booking or payment. No ratings or Review schema.

audience: A Singapore-passport couple in their early thirties planning a no-driving February Iceland trip; Chinese-speaking Singapore residents can use the same planning comparison without inheriting passport eligibility.
localeReason: English and Chinese: a popular travel decision for Chinese-speaking Singapore residents too. The Singapore couple’s passport, prior Schengen stay and entry assumptions are retained, not adapted into eligibility for other passports.
